تحفظ باہم ہراسانی خواتین بمقام کار ایکٹ 2010 کے تحت آپ کو یہ اختیار حاصل ہے کہ آپ اپنے ادارے کی انکوائری کمیٹی یا محتسب کو شکایت درج کروا سکتی ہیں۔ آجر کے لیے لازمی ہے کہ وہ ادارے میں انکوائری کمیٹی قائم کرے اور ضابطہ اخلاق کو نمایاں جگہ پر آویزاں کرے۔ اگر آپ پہلے غیر رسمی طریقہ اپنایا چاہتی ہیں تو آپ کسی نگراں یا کمیٹی کے رکن سے محرمانہ مشورہ یا مصالحت کے لیے بات کر سکتی ہیں۔ تحقیقات کے دوران آجر کو چاہیے کہ وہ عارضی انتظام کرے تاکہ آپ کو مینیجر سے کاروباری رابطے نہ کرنے پڑیں۔

- اپنے ادارے میں قائم انکوائری کمیٹی یا آویزاں ضابطہ اخلاق کے بارے میں معلومات حاصل کریں۔
- انکوائری کمیٹی یا محتسب کے پاس تحریری شکایت جمع کروائیں یا غیر رسمی حل کے لیے رابطہ کریں۔
میرا مینیجر مجھے کام پر تنگ کرتا ہے میں.answer_en:
Under the Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010 (as amended), you have the option to submit a complaint either directly to the Inquiry Committee set up within your organization or to the Ombudsperson. Employers are legally required to establish an Inquiry Committee and display the Code of Conduct at the workplace. If you prefer an informal approach first, you may report the incident to a supervisor or a member of the Inquiry Committee for confidential advice or mediation. During an investigation, the employer should make temporary adjustments so you do not have to interact with the manager for official purposes.

Next Steps:
- Check if your organization has an Inquiry Committee or Code of Conduct displayed.
- Consider filing a formal written complaint with the Inquiry Committee or the Ombudsperson, or talk to a trusted member for an informal resolution.

If you are receiving less than the required rate, you may verify your specific employment details with the Labour Department or consult a legal professional regarding your rights under the Act.

میرے بھائی مجھے والد کی زمین میں حصہ نہی.answer_ur: پنجاب میں خواتین کے حقوق ملکیت کے تحفظ کے قانون 2021 کے تحت اگر کسی خاتون کو اس کی جائیداد کی ملکیت یا قبضے سے محروم کیا جائے تو وہ محتسب کو درخواست دے سکتی ہے۔ اگر یہ بات ثابت ہو جائے کہ آپ کو جائیداد کے حق سے محروم رکھا گیا ہے تو محتسب ڈپٹی کمشنر کو قبضہ یا ملکیت بحال کرنے کا حکم دے سکتا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ محتسب جائیداد سے محروم رکھنے والے فرد کو اس عرصے کا کرایہ ادا کرنے کا حکم بھی دے سکتا ہے۔ آپ اپنے حق کے حصول کے لیے پنجاب کی زنانی محتسب (وومن محتسب) کے پاس تحریری شکایت درج کروا سکتی ہیں۔
میرے بھائی مجھے والد کی زمین میں حصہ نہی.answer_en: Under the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2021, if a woman is deprived of ownership or possession of her property (including inherited property), she can file a complaint with the Ombudsperson (Section 4). If the Ombudsperson finds that you have been illegally deprived of your property rights, they can direct the Deputy Commissioner or state authorities to restore your possession or title (Section 5). Furthermore, under Section 8, the Ombudsperson can direct the person depriving you of the property to pay rent for the period you were deprived of its use. You can submit a written complaint to the Punjab Women Ombudsperson to initiate proceedings.

my manager keeps sending me unwelcome me.answer_en:
Under the Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010 (Schedule), harassment includes unwelcome verbal or written communication of a sexual nature, sexual advances, or sexually demeaning attitudes that create an intimidating, hostile, or offensive work environment. 

You have options for how to address this:
1. Informal Approach: Under the Code of Conduct (Schedule), you may report the incident informally to a supervisor or a member of the workplace Inquiry Committee orally or in writing. This can lead to confidential mediation, advice, or counseling.
2. Formal Complaint: Under Section 8(1), an employee has the option to submit a formal complaint either to the workplace Inquiry Committee or directly to the Ombudsperson.

Next Steps:
- Keep copies/screenshots of all unwelcome messages and note down dates and details.
- Consider reporting the conduct informally to your supervisor or Inquiry Committee member, or lodge a formal complaint with the Inquiry Committee or the Ombudsperson.

Under the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2021 (Section 4), if you are a woman who has been deprived of ownership or possession of your property in Punjab, you can file a complaint with the Provincial Ombudsperson, provided no court case is currently pending regarding the property. If a court case is already pending, you can also file a complaint under Section 7. 

If the Ombudsperson finds that you have been illegally deprived of your property, they can order the Deputy Commissioner or state functionaries to restore your ownership or possession (Section 5). Additionally, under Section 8, the Ombudsperson may order the person who deprived you of your property to pay you rent equivalent to the prevailing market rate for the period you were deprived of its use. 

Next Steps:
1. Gather your father's property documents, family registration certificate (FRC), and relevant records.
2. File a formal complaint with the Punjab Ombudsperson's office for the enforcement of your property rights.
3. You can generate a complaint letter using this platform to assist you in submitting your claim.
